Nagpur sits at the centre of India's logistics map, and its industrial zones — MIHAN, Butibori MIDC, and the Hingna belt — keep up steady demand for site offices, security cabins, and worker accommodation. SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd manufactures IS 2062 MS-frame porta cabins at our Greater Noida factory and dispatches them to Nagpur in 3 to 5 days via the NH-44 corridor. For Nagpur's hot, dusty summers we build with proper insulation and ventilation as standard. Whether you need a security cabin at a Butibori plot or a multi-room office at a MIHAN logistics park, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 for specifications and a price.

Why Nagpur Buyers Choose SAMAN

The porta cabin results a Nagpur buyer finds online are mostly IndiaMART and TradeIndia listing pages — directories that mix many suppliers and reveal nothing about frame grade, panel thickness, or heat insulation. For a city where summer temperatures regularly cross 44°C, insulation is not optional.

SAMAN is the manufacturer. Call us and you reach the team that builds the cabin. As a direct manufacturer of porta cabins, every unit leaves our factory with:

  • IS 2062 Grade A MS hollow-section frame, zinc-phosphate primed and powder-coated
  • 50 mm PUF sandwich panels — genuine thermal insulation for Nagpur's heat
  • Colour-coated GI roof with internal false ceiling and optional turbo ventilators
  • Pre-wired MCB board with ELCB earthing

We hold ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), plus NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition. Started 2009, incorporated 2019 as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd (POS = Portable Office Solutions). 500+ projects delivered across India.

Delivery: ₹3,000 standard. Transit to Nagpur: 3–5 days from Greater Noida. Returns: 7 days, return freight at buyer's cost.

Nagpur's Industries and Porta Cabin Demand

Nagpur's position as Maharashtra's logistics and Vidarbha's industrial hub creates several distinct sources of porta cabin demand:

MIHAN and Khapri (PIN 441108): The Multi-modal International Cargo Hub and Airport at Nagpur is one of central India's biggest infrastructure projects — SEZ units, aerospace MRO, IT, and logistics warehouses. Greenfield construction and operating sites here need multi-room contractor offices, security cabins at SEZ gate entries, and site-management units. MIHAN is a high-volume, project-driven demand source.

Butibori MIDC (PIN 441122): One of Asia's largest industrial estates by area — power, steel, textiles, and heavy engineering. Plant gate security cabins, portable QC rooms, and supervisor offices are recurring requirements. The scale of Butibori means orders often run to multiple cabins per project.

Hingna MIDC (PIN 440016): Auto components, engineering, and the electronics zone. Compact security posts and portable tool stores at plot entries are the common format here.

Logistics and warehousing corridors: Nagpur's central location makes it a national distribution hub. New warehouse and cold-chain construction along the Wardha Road and Outer Ring Road corridors uses porta cabins as site offices and security gate cabins through the build phase.

Infrastructure projects: Nagpur Metro expansion, the Samruddhi Mahamarg (Nagpur-Mumbai Expressway) interchange works, and national highway upgrades all generate contractor-office and labour-accommodation demand.

We dispatch from Greater Noida down the NH-44 (Agra-Gwalior-Jhansi-Nagpur) corridor — a direct route that brings cabins to Nagpur in 3–5 days.

Porta Cabin Specifications — Built for Nagpur's Heat

Nagpur's climate is demanding: long, dry summers above 44°C, dust, and a monsoon season. Every cabin is specified for these conditions.

The two specifications that matter most for Nagpur are the steel grade and the panel. We build the frame from IS 2062 Grade A mild steel — the same structural standard used for industrial fabrication — because a site cabin in a dusty, high-temperature environment has to hold its shape and resist corrosion for years, not months. The 50 mm PUF sandwich panel is what separates a usable summer cabin from a bare metal box: the foam core slows heat transfer through the walls and roof, so the interior stays cooler than the outside air. On our cabins these are not paid upgrades — they are the standard build, with cement-board panels offered as an alternative for long-term outdoor industrial use.

Frame: IS 2062 Grade A mild steel hollow sections. Welded, zinc-phosphate primed, powder-coated, anchor-bolted to an RCC plinth.

Panels: 50 mm PUF sandwich panels standard — their insulation value is what keeps a Nagpur cabin usable through the summer. Cement-board panels available for longer-term outdoor industrial installations.

Roofing: Colour-coated GI sheet with internal false ceiling — essential for heat. Turbo ventilators strongly recommended for open Butibori and MIHAN sites with no shade.

Flooring: Anti-skid chequered MS plate or commercial-grade laminate (chequered plate preferred in dusty industrial sites — easier to clean).

Doors and windows: MS frame, powder-coat finish, louvre or sliding windows; fixed glazing on request. All factory-fitted.

Electrical: Pre-wired MCB board, 2–4 power points per room, tube-light provision, ELCB.

Standard sizes: 8×10 ft · 10×12 ft · 10×20 ft · 10×30 ft · 10×40 ft · custom sizes accepted.

Configurations: single room, two-room, multi-room block, with attached toilet/washroom, with pantry.

Applications in Nagpur

  • Security cabins at MIHAN SEZ gates and Butibori plant entries
  • Multi-room contractor offices at MIHAN greenfield and warehouse construction
  • Labour accommodation blocks at Samruddhi Mahamarg and large MIDC projects
  • Portable QC and inspection rooms near Butibori power and steel lines
  • Site-management offices at Nagpur Metro and Outer Ring Road construction
  • Compact stores and supervisor cabins at Hingna engineering units
  • Logistics-park gate and weighbridge cabins along the Wardha Road corridor

Choosing the Right Porta Cabin for Your Nagpur Site

The right configuration depends on how the cabin will be used and how long it stays on site. A few practical guidelines we share with Nagpur buyers:

Security cabins: For a single guard at a Butibori or MIHAN gate, an 8×10 ft single-room unit with a sliding window, a powder-coated MS door, and one or two power points is usually enough. Add a small toilet provision only if the post is manned around the clock.

Site offices: A contractor running a MIHAN warehouse build or a Samruddhi Mahamarg stretch typically needs a 10×20 ft or 10×30 ft unit with two or three rooms, a meeting space, an attached toilet, and AC provision. A light exterior colour and an internal false ceiling keep it workable through the summer months.

Labour accommodation: For worker colonies on large MIDC or expressway projects, multi-room 10×40 ft blocks with cross-ventilation and separate toilet-washroom units are the standard. These are usually ordered in sets, so confirm the per-unit rate for the full quantity at quotation.

Short-term vs long-term: For a project running under three years, standard PUF panels are the economical choice. For a permanent gatehouse or a unit exposed to a harsh industrial environment, cement-board panels extend service life. Tell us how long the cabin will stay and we will match the panel and coating to it.

Customisation Options

  • Custom dimensions and multi-room layouts
  • RAL colour choice — light colours recommended for Nagpur sun
  • Air-conditioning provision (wall-sleeve cut-out + power point) — practical for any working office in Nagpur summer
  • Turbo ventilator + false ceiling for heat management (recommended)
  • Internal partitions, extra doors/windows
  • Plumbing for attached toilet or washroom
  • Two-storey stacking where load calculations allow

Share your site location and conditions; we confirm specification and price at quotation stage. We also serve other Maharashtra cities from the same factory dispatch — see our porta cabin in Pune and porta cabin in Nashik pages.

Porta Cabin Price in Nagpur — Cost Factors

  1. Size — 8×10 ft single room is entry-level; 10×40 ft block is the upper end.
  2. Panel choice — PUF (standard insulation) vs cement-board.
  3. Heat-management additions — turbo ventilator, false ceiling, AC provision are practical necessities for Nagpur and should be budgeted upfront.
  4. Fit-out — bare shell vs fully fitted (electrical, flooring, paint, AC).
  5. Quantity — 5+ units attract better per-unit pricing. Confirm at quotation.

For an accurate porta cabin price in Nagpur for your size and site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937.

What to Share When You Enquire

To give you an accurate quotation for a porta cabin in Nagpur in a single call, it helps to have a few details ready:

  • The size or floor plan you need, or the number of people the cabin must hold
  • How the cabin will be used — security post, office, store, or accommodation
  • Your delivery location in Nagpur — MIHAN, Butibori, Hingna, or a construction-site address
  • How long the cabin will stay on site, which guides the panel and coating choice
  • Whether you need AC provision, a toilet, partitions, or two-storey stacking
  • The quantity, since multi-unit orders change the per-unit price

With these in hand we confirm the specification, a firm price, and a delivery timeline without back-and-forth. Vendor-documentation requirements are prepared at the same stage for project and government buyers, so nothing holds up your purchase order once you decide.

Delivery and Installation in Nagpur

We dispatch from Greater Noida (Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, UP 201308) down the NH-44 corridor on flatbed trucks. Transit: 3–5 days. We handle factory dispatch across North India and onward to Nagpur on the same factory-direct basis. On arrival the cabin is set on your pre-cast RCC plinth, anchor-bolted, panels checked, and the MCB board connected. A single-room cabin is ready within hours; a multi-room block in about a day. Delivery: ₹3,000 standard; confirm consolidated rate for multiple cabins. We have no Nagpur warehouse or branch — every cabin is built to order and delivered direct to your site.

Before the cabin arrives, prepare a level base at the placement point. For most single cabins a simple RCC plinth or a compacted, levelled pad with support blocks at the load points is enough; multi-room blocks and two-storey units need a properly cast RCC plinth sized to the cabin footprint. Our team can advise on the base requirement for your unit and site soil when you place the order, so the cabin can be set, bolted, and handed over in one visit.

GST, Documentation, and Vendor Empanelment

Porta cabins are classified under HSN 9406 (prefabricated structures) and attract 18% GST. We issue a full tax invoice from SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd against our Noida GST registration (09ABBCS7101B1ZT), with e-way bill and lorry-receipt documentation for your site accounts. For Nagpur's industrial and infrastructure buyers this paperwork matters: MIHAN SEZ units, MIDC contractors, and government project managers usually need clean vendor documentation before a purchase order is raised. Our ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018 certificates, NSIC enlistment (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207), DPIIT recognition (DIPP56005), PAN, and incorporation documents are all available for empanelment. Share your project requirement and we will provide the document set your procurement team needs alongside the quotation.

Frequently Asked Questions — Porta Cabin in Nagpur

Does SAMAN deliver porta cabins to MIHAN, Butibori, and Hingna MIDC?

Yes. We deliver to all Nagpur industrial zones — MIHAN, Butibori MIDC, Hingna MIDC — and to construction sites across the Nagpur region. Transit from our Greater Noida factory is 3–5 days. Delivery charge is ₹3,000 standard.

How does a porta cabin handle Nagpur's extreme summer heat?

The 50 mm PUF sandwich panels provide genuine thermal insulation, and we recommend a turbo ventilator plus an internal false ceiling on all Nagpur orders. For a working office used through summer, add an AC provision (wall-sleeve + power point). A light exterior colour reduces solar heat gain. With these, the cabin stays usable even above 44°C; a bare cabin in direct sun does not.

What is the price of a porta cabin in Nagpur?

Price depends on size, panel type, heat-management additions, and fit-out level. Call +91 87960 39938 or send an enquiry for a quotation built for your site and specification. We do not publish fixed prices because every cabin is built to order.

Can SAMAN supply porta cabins for a MIHAN, Samruddhi Mahamarg, or government project?

Yes. We supply industrial contractors, infrastructure project managers, and government contractors. Our NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition, ISO certificates, GST registration, and incorporation documents are available for vendor empanelment. Share your project scope and we will confirm supply capacity and timeline.

How long does delivery from the factory to Nagpur take?

3–5 days from our Greater Noida factory via the NH-44 corridor, after production is complete. Production lead time depends on your configuration and the order queue — confirm at enquiry. Standard sizes move faster.

Get a Quote for Your Porta Cabin in Nagpur

For a porta cabin in Nagpur delivered to your MIDC plot, MIHAN site, or construction project, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or send an enquiry using the form below. We will respond with the right specification for Nagpur's conditions, a delivery timeline, and a firm quotation. See our MS steel porta cabin build options for the full range of sizes, configurations, and specifications.
